So
Is something actually wrong with you?
Actually, yes.
You are not normal, / and that's the point.
Success is abnormal
by definition.
Successful people are outliers. / They do not belong to the average.
Which sounds great,
except it comes with a price most people won't pay.
Pain, / discomfort,
going further than most people could ever tolerate.
That's why balance does not hold up while you are chasing a big goal.
Balance is something everybody can do, and if everybody can do it, / there's no value in it.
It's like a class where everybody gets an A.
The A means nothing.
Screw balance. You need to go all out.
But here's the problem.
The moment it gets uncomfortable is the exact moment you have to keep going.
That discomfort is what makes you grow
It tells your body and mind there's no option but to adapt and become stronger.
And it's exactly where most people chicken out and crawl back into comfort.
Outliers keep going,
and that is when the judging starts.
Normal people don't look at themselves.
They look at you.
Crazy, boring, obsessed,
whatever helps them feel better about their own mediocrity
You, my friend, were never supposed to be normal
